messages:
deploybot: [migration-slot] Request to claim maintenance window 03/23 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-4921 (shadow index + compact backfill). Claiming slot; canaries=2. Please ack or cancel within 15m.
Elaine: Heads-up: this migration will add an index on profiles(email) using a shadow index then perform a deterministic swap. Backfill is chunked to avoid replication lag. Short exclusive lock expected only during rename/swap step (~200–500ms).
Devon: Quick Q — are we using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY or a parallel chunked INSERT approach? CONCURRENTLY can still cause bloat on replicas.
Elaine: We'll use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for initial build, then a rename-swap for zero-downtime cutover. Backfill throttle set to 500 rows/sec; adapt if replica_lag > 30s.
SRE-oncall: I set prechecks: replica lag check, long-running tx detector, and autothrottle hook. If replica_lag > 20s for >2m during build we auto-throttle to 200 r/s and post to #eng-sre. Alert thresholds patched to 95th p99 latency +10%.
Maria: I can own the cutover window. I'll be oncall 02:00-03:30 UTC and watching metrics.
Devon: Please pin the service to release tag release-3.1.2 for the canary nodes so we don't get a runtime/DB mismatch. If we see index-backed failures we'll roll the canary back to release-3.1.1.
Elaine: Will pin. Also adding a migration feature-flag so new code paths can be gated until swap completes.
SRE-oncall: Quick runbook checklist snippet:
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle in transaction');
SELECT client_addr, state_change FROM pg_stat_replication WHERE state='streaming';
-- monitor progress
SELECT phase, COALESCE(total_blocks,0), COALESCE(done_blocks,0) FROM migration_progress WHERE migration_id='m-4921';
```
Devon: Love the runbook. Two rollback options documented: 1) abort backfill and keep old index (no swap) — service continues to use old index; 2) if swap completed and regression seen, rename old index back and re-point constraints (requires brief lock).
Ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required before release to prod. Auto-abort if preflight fails.
Elaine: Deployment plan: canary on 2 shards at 02:00. If canaries show no errors + latency < +5% for 10m, proceed to prod. If any canary error, abort and revert canary pin.
SRE-oncall: Acked. I'll run the health probes and escalate if p99 token latency > 250ms or replica lag > 30s.
Maria: Adding quick smoke test: curl /api/v1/profile?email=a@b.com and ensure index-backed response < 120ms. I'll paste results in thread during cutover.
Devon: Noted. Elaine, drop the migration SQL here when ready so we can sanity-check.
Elaine: SQL (sanitized):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS profiles_email_idx_shadow ON profiles ((lower(email))) WITH (fillfactor=90);
-- chunked backfill worker runs until done
-- swap: begin; LOCK TABLE profiles IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX profiles_email_idx_shadow RENAME TO profiles_email_idx; commit;
```
Devon: OK looks good. One more: set glich-check flag to ignore temporary duplicate index metrics for 1h.
SRE-oncall: Will patch dashboards to hide transient noise.
Maria: Oncall and ready. :thumbsup:
Elaine: Proceeding to claim the slot. Deploybot — start canary at 02:00 UTC.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Canaries scheduled. Will post status updates.
